description.name: Advanced Client Verification
description.tagline: Enterprise-grade automated and manual KYC verification module for WHMCS by HostNibo.
description.long: Enterprise-grade automated and manual KYC verification module for WHMCS by HostNibo. Supports biometric automated KYC verification with Didit integration, manual government-issued ID and document review, risk evaluation, duplicate document detection, private AES-256 encrypted storage, and complete audit logging.
features: Biometric automated KYC verification with Didit integration
Manual government-issued ID and document review workflow
Hybrid verification modes with automatic fallback
Custom KYC product rules, categories, and client group enforcement
Risk evaluation and duplicate document detection
Private AES-256 encrypted document storage outside the web root
Multi-channel email notifications and configurable admin routing
Complete verification audit timeline and compliance logging
